description: mastodon: Fetch one status. GET /v1/mastodon/status. One public status by id on instance. HTML is returned as content and as text with tags removed. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.

name: mastodon_status
